payload.title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
payload.goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path

payload.text:
Finished per-tenant webhook rate limiting.

What I did:
- Previous run had already added `RateLimiter` in `src/lib/limiter.ts`, `rateLimitMaxRequests` / `rateLimitWindowMs` in `src/config.ts` via `loadConfig()` with defaults, and `limiter` in `Deps` via `createDeps()` in `src/app.ts`.
- I wired the limiter into `src/routes/webhooks.ts`: after tenant validation, `deps.limiter.check(tenant, deps.config.rateLimitMaxRequests, deps.config.rateLimitWindowMs)` returns 429 `{ error: 'rate limit exceeded' }` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds until window slides) when over limit.
- I fixed a typecheck error in `src/lib/limiter.ts` (`recent[0]` possibly undefined).
- I added `test/webhooks-rate-limit.test.ts` covering: 429 + `Retry-After` on excess, other tenants unaffected, limit/window read from config, window slide recovery, and `loadConfig` defaults/env.
- I updated `test/config.test.ts` expectations for the two new config fields.
- Verified with `bun run test` (32 tests, 7 files pass) and `bun run typecheck` (clean).

decision: Rate limiter is an in-memory per-tenant sliding-window counter in src/lib/limiter.ts, shared via Deps.limiter so all routes/tests use the same instance.
decision: Rate-limit check runs after tenant auth but before body parsing, so the limit and window come only from loadConfig() with no constants in the route.
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because loadConfig now returns rateLimitMaxRequests and rateLimitWindowMs defaults and env values.

What I did not finish:
- No persistent/distributed limiter (in-memory only, resets on restart); no per-route tuning beyond the two config keys; rejected (429) hits do not write audit entries.

What I did not look at:
- The review-voice-policy skill (no policy file involved); `src/server.ts`, replay/backoff logic, and admin/audit routes beyond confirming Deps wiring.
